Description: Tendency to help, care, and avoid harm; higher = more prosocial.
Notes: Used with Trust/Respect for social choices.

Description: Tendency to lead, confront, impose boundaries; higher = more dominant.
Notes: Low values may 'absorb' conflicts before reacting.

Description: Preference for structure, rules, planning; higher = more orderly.
Drive to explore, improvise, learn by doing; higher = more curious.
Comfort with danger and uncertainty; higher = more risk-taking.
Notes: Affects threat responses and bold actions.

Description: Ability to wait, tolerate frustration; higher = more patient.
Notes: High values delay escalation; pairs with VOLATILITY.

Description: How strongly emotions spike under stress; higher = more reactive.
Notes: Used with Stress and Outburst rules.

Description: Default assumption about others; higher = more trusting.
Notes: Low values detect manipulation and assume malice.

Description: Higher = more principle-driven; lower = more pragmatic/ends-justify.
Notes: Supports lawful vs opportunistic moral styles.

Description: Higher = more direct/blunt; lower = more tactful/indirect.
Notes: Can be temporarily overridden in OUTBURST.
